items.heading: Bratwurst with Sauerkraut
details: Key ingredients: bratwurst sausages, sauerkraut, onion, mustard
Simmer or grill bratwurst sausages until cooked through and browned.
Warm sauerkraut with sauteed onion until heated through.
Plate the sausages alongside the sauerkraut.
Serve with mustard and crusty bread.

items.heading: Pretzel
details: Key ingredients: flour, yeast, water, baking soda, coarse salt
Knead a simple yeasted dough and let it rise until doubled.
Shape ropes of dough into the classic pretzel twist.
Dip briefly in a baking soda solution before baking, which gives the dark crust.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake until deep golden brown.

items.heading: Black Forest Cake
details: Key ingredients: chocolate sponge, cherries, whipped cream, kirsch
Bake layers of chocolate sponge cake and let them cool.
Soak the layers lightly with kirsch and cherry syrup.
Fill and frost between layers with whipped cream and cherries.
Decorate the top with more whipped cream, cherries and chocolate shavings.
